{{Top|leg}}
A '''laserball''' was a type of toy children played with. It gave off a strange orange light, and bounced quite high. It was harmless and not a weapon.

[[The Young]] shot laserballs out of [[Slingshot/Legends|slingshots]] on [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. Although they only stung on impact, these laserballs would make a loud sound like [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire upon hitting a solid surface.
